description: Use this skill when the user asks about DataQ — FMCSA's data review system at dataqs.fmcsa.dot.gov — for disputing inspection violations, crash records, or other entries that appear in a carrier's CSA / SMS score. Covers Request for Data Review (RDR) process, success rates, common dispute grounds, what evidence to attach, timeline expectations, and how successful disputes reduce BSI (BASIC Severity Indicator) scores. Cite 49 CFR 392.7 and the FMCSA DataQs User Guide.
